parent_scope_objection: Second and final scientific review; initial1spent. NEW full original/supplement disproves the simple title-based objection that Rung never tested fasting glucose, but also reveals original authors explicitly report no FPG association across three cohorts, mainDESIRadditiveP0.05, supplementDESIRadditive0.06/recessive0.02. Current additive logFPG tests local proxies because rs2943641unavailable; currentTable2prints originalP0.05, different from originalT2D9e-12. Decide whether this is an actual original-specific empirical retest (including a published null/boundary finding) or merely extension from diabetes/insulin locus to different trait/model. Do not require an original finding to be significant to be eligible. Do not accept shared locus or authors replication label alone; inspect original tested trait, models, alleles and current specific comparison. Dupuis2010main has other IRS1 insulin/resistance associations, but that does not prove same FPGclaim or an absence in uninspected supplements. Distinguish empirical work/closest finding-chain from overlapping investigators/data. NO outcome decision requested. Retain real claim/trait/chain ambiguity if unresolved. No new replicating source/coding promotion; old positive opinion preserved.
